metadata.institute: Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai (IIT Bhilai)

councils.name: Science and Technology Council
councils.description: The Sci-Tech Council serves as a dynamic hub of innovation, curiosity, and technical excellence at IIT Bhilai, bringing together students passionate about science and technology. Led by the General Secretary of the Science and Technology Council, it encompasses ten active clubs and societies covering diverse domains such as coding, ethical hacking, web development, robotics, astronomy, open source, artificial intelligence, data science, and more.

councils.name: Cultural Council
councils.description: At IIT Bhilai, culture is the heartbeat of campus life, providing students with a platform to express creativity, explore passions, and grow beyond academics. Led by the General Secretary of Cultural and Media Affairs, the Cultural Council fosters a vibrant ecosystem where art, performance, literature, media, and innovation thrive.

councils.name: Sports Council
councils.description: Oversees athletic conditioning, sports grounds, Inter-IIT training contingents, and intra-college leagues.

councils.name: Media and Publication Body
councils.description: Documents campus life, runs the official student newspaper, creates cinematic aftermovies, and manages public relations.

councils.name: Student Welfare and Governance
councils.description: Represents student interests in academic affairs, hostel amenities, mess nutrition, community service, and peer mentorship.

clubs.name: OpenLake: The Open Source Development Society
clubs.tagline: Building open source culture at IIT Bhilai
clubs.description: OpenLake is IIT Bhilai's vibrant open-source community, dedicated to fostering innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning through the spirit of open-source development. By building, breaking, fixing, and improving projects, members gain hands-on experience with real-world software while contributing to impactful technologies. Whether you are an experienced developer or just starting your coding journey, OpenLake provides a welcoming environment to learn, collaborate, and grow alongside a passionate community of creators and problem-solvers. See you soon in the flow.

clubs.name: The Epsilon Club - Robotics Club
clubs.tagline: Innovating the future of robotics and automation
clubs.description: Epsilon is IIT Bhilai's Robotics and Mechatronics Club, dedicated to fostering innovation, creativity, and technical excellence. Established in 2017 with the motto “Imagine, Invent, Inspire,” the club provides a platform for students passionate about technology to transform their ideas into real-world projects and prototypes. Through hands-on learning, technical workshops, collaborative projects, and innovation-driven activities, Epsilon helps members develop practical skills, critical thinking, and a strong engineering mindset. Whether you are an experienced builder or a curious beginner, Epsilon welcomes you to learn, create, and build the future together.

clubs.name: Electromos - Electronics Club
clubs.tagline: Bridging silicon, circuits, and intelligent hardware
clubs.description: Electromos is IIT Bhilai's electronics club, dedicated to exploring IoT, embedded systems, circuit design, and simulation. Through workshops, hands-on projects, and collaborative learning, members gain practical experience in electronics, microcontroller programming, and IoT-based solutions. The club fosters innovation, technical skills, and creativity, providing a platform for students of all experience levels to learn, build, and shape the future of electronics technology.

clubs.name: Ingenuity: Competitive Programming Club
clubs.tagline: Mastering algorithms, structures, and competitive problem solving
clubs.description: Ingenuity is a student-led initiative dedicated to algorithms, problem-solving, and competitive programming. Through coding contests, technical workshops, and peer-driven challenges, it provides a platform for students to enhance their logical thinking, algorithmic skills, and coding proficiency. By fostering collaboration, learning, and healthy competition, Ingenuity empowers members to tackle challenging problems and grow as programmers. Gear up to explore the world of logic and innovation—we look forward to coding our way to success together.

clubs.name: DSAI Club - Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
clubs.tagline: Unlocking intelligence from data and modern machine learning
clubs.description: The DSAI Club at IIT Bhilai explores the exciting fields of data science, artificial intelligence, and machine learning through hands-on projects, workshops, research initiatives, and peer learning. As a collaborative platform for innovation and problem-solving, the club enables students to develop practical skills, explore emerging technologies, and build intelligent, data-driven solutions. The DSAI Club warmly welcomes you to IIT Bhilai and looks forward to being a part of your journey in the world of data and AI.
key_projects: Campus Automated Attendance via Face Recognition

clubs.name: Space Exploration Society: Astronomy and Aeronautics Society (SES)
clubs.tagline: Reaching beyond the horizon into the cosmos
clubs.description: The Space Exploration Society (SES) is IIT Bhilai's premier astronomy and aeronautics society, dedicated to exploring the wonders of space and flight. Through telescope observations, astrophysics activities, aeromodelling projects, RC aircraft, drones, and drone swarms, SES provides students with exciting opportunities to learn and innovate. By organizing workshops, observation sessions, competitions, and hands-on projects, the society fosters curiosity, technical skills, and a passion for discovery, welcoming all students interested in exploring the cosmos and aerospace technologies.

clubs.name: IIT Bhilai Motorsports
clubs.tagline: Engineering speed, endurance, and terrain mastery
clubs.description: IIT Bhilai Motorsports is a student-driven technical club that promotes innovation in automotive engineering through hands-on learning and competitive projects. Team Agnishul, the club's official BAJA SAEINDIA team, designs, manufactures, and tests All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) for national-level competitions. With over 30 dedicated members, the club provides practical experience in vehicle design, analysis, manufacturing, testing, and problem-solving while fostering teamwork and leadership. Join IIT Bhilai Motorsports to turn your passion for engineering into real-world innovation.
key_projects: Custom Chromoly Steel ATV Roll Cage

clubs.name: BIB: Blockchain Society of IIT Bhilai
clubs.tagline: Exploring decentralized technologies, Web3, and blockchain solutions
clubs.description: Blockchain Innovation Base (BIB) is IIT Bhilai’s student community for blockchain and Web3 enthusiasts, dedicated to exploring decentralized technologies through projects, workshops, research, and collaborative learning. Members gain hands-on experience in areas such as smart contracts, decentralized finance (DeFi), NFTs, and emerging Web3 innovations while developing practical solutions to real-world challenges. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced developer, BIB offers a platform to learn, innovate, and grow within a vibrant blockchain community.

clubs.name: DesignX
clubs.tagline: Crafting visual identities and seamless digital experiences
clubs.description: At the heart of the Cultural Council's creative vision, DesignX serves as the go-to hub for students passionate about graphic design, UI/UX, and the art of visual communication. From building brand identities and crafting eye-catching posters to designing seamless website interfaces and immersive interactive experiences, the club empowers members to push the boundaries of their digital creativity. Members sharpen their skills through hands-on workshops, take on real-world collaborative projects, and put their talent to the test in competitions, all while working with the same industry-standard tools used by professionals.
key_projects: Meraz & Cultscape Festival Visual Identity Design

clubs.name: Developers Student Club (GDG)
clubs.tagline: Connecting developers to Google developer technologies
clubs.description: The Developers Student Club (DSC) is a vibrant community that empowers students to grow as developers through peer-to-peer learning and hands-on experiences. Focused on areas such as app and web development, cloud computing, open-source contributions, and real-world projects, DSC helps bridge the gap between academic learning and industry-relevant technologies. Through workshops, hackathons, coding sessions, and tech talks, the club fosters innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced programmer, DSC provides a platform to build, learn, and grow together.
key_projects: Community Solutions for UN Sustainable Development Goals

clubs.name: Spectre – The Cybersecurity Club
clubs.tagline: Learn to break systems !! — Ethical hacking, CTFs, and system defense
clubs.description: Spectre, the Cybersecurity Club of IIT Bhilai, is a community of security enthusiasts dedicated to developing skills to tackle modern cybersecurity challenges. Through CTFs, hands-on sessions, workshops, and collaborative learning, the club fosters practical experience, problem-solving, and teamwork. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced hacker, Spectre offers a platform to learn, grow, and help secure the digital future—one byte at a time.
flagship_events: Binary Exploitation & Web Penetration Testing Sprints

clubs.name: Drishya (The Dramatics Club)
clubs.tagline: Illuminating stories from the street to the grand stage
clubs.description: Drishya, the Dramatics Club of the Cultural Council, is a dynamic platform that nurtures creativity, confidence, and artistic expression among students. The club provides opportunities to explore acting, scriptwriting, direction, production, technical work, and stage management through impactful performances and collaborative learning. From intense stage plays to socially driven nukkad nataks, Drishya encourages students to use theatre as a medium for storytelling and change. The club continuously works towards creating meaningful performances that entertain, inspire, and engage audiences across campus and beyond.
key_projects: Social Awareness Street Play Tours across Durg-Bhilai

clubs.name: Beathackers (The Dance Club)
clubs.tagline: Setting the rhythm, dominating the dance floor
clubs.description: Beathackers, the official Dance Club of IIT Bhilai under the Cultural Council, is a vibrant space for rhythm, energy, creativity, and stage expression. The club brings together passionate dancers from different backgrounds and encourages them to explore various dance styles such as hip-hop, freestyle, contemporary, classical, and fusion. The club aims to build a strong dance culture on campus by conducting regular practice sessions, workshops, choreo-building activities, performances, and dance battles. Beathackers provides students a platform to learn, collaborate, improve their confidence, and showcase their talent in institute events, cultural nights, competitions, and inter-college platforms.
key_projects: Annual Inter-IIT Dance Contingent Video Showcase

clubs.name: Swara (The Music Club)
clubs.tagline: Harmony, melody, and soulful acoustic resonance
clubs.description: Swara is a vibrant community of singers, instrumentalists, composers, and music enthusiasts united by a shared love for music. The club provides a platform for students to explore their musical talents, refine their skills, and express themselves through diverse genres and performances. Through live concerts, jam sessions, open mics, workshops, competitions, and special musical events, Swara enriches campus life and creates memorable experiences for both performers and audiences. The club also proudly represents IIT Bhilai at cultural festivals and inter-collegiate events, showcasing its musical talent beyond the campus.
flagship_events: Battle of the Bands at Meraz
key_projects: Original Campus Band Compositions & Studio Tracks

clubs.name: Renaissance — The Fine Arts Club
clubs.tagline: Giving life to imagination through canvas, brush, and sculpture
clubs.description: Where imagination meets craftsmanship. Renaissance is IIT Bhilai's creative sanctuary for artists of every kind — from painters and sketchers to calligraphers and digital artists. Through workshops, art sessions, event decorations, and representation at the Inter IIT Cultural Meet, we shape the visual soul of the campus. But more than a club, we are a close-knit, happy family where creativity and fun go hand in hand. Whether you're a seasoned artist or someone who's never picked up a brush — if you have the urge to create, Renaissance is your home.

clubs.name: General Oratory and Literary Society (GOALS)
clubs.tagline: The arena of eloquent thought, debate, and literary expression
clubs.description: The General Oratory And Literary Society is not just any society, it serves as a haven for one to harbor creativity, critical thinking and wield the acme of negotiation and conflict management. From our amusing stand-ups to elaborate debates, speeches and literary discussions everything leads to one goal, fostering the culture of eloquence, knowledge and purely insane enjoyment.
flagship_events: Campus Poetry Slams & Open Mic Nights
key_projects: Annual Student Anthology of Poems & Short Stories

clubs.name: Quizzotica
clubs.tagline: Celebrating curiosity, trivia, and the thrill of knowledge
clubs.description: Fuel your curiosity with Quizzotica, the ultimate hub for quiz enthusiasts under the Cultural Council. This is where intellect meets adrenaline in high-energy battles of knowledge spanning science, history, pop culture, sports, and beyond. Join us to test your fast-thinking skills, sharpen your mental recall, and grow alongside the sharpest minds on campus.
flagship_events: Weekly Friday Night Pub & Trivia Quizzes
key_projects: Comprehensive Campus Quiz Repository & Question Bank

clubs.name: Inside Club
clubs.tagline: The voice, pulse, and chronicler of IIT Bhilai
clubs.description: Inside Club is the official student journalism, newsletter, and press organization of IIT Bhilai. It publishes student opinions, covers administration circulars, conducts interviews with faculty and visiting dignitaries, and publishes semester magazines.

clubs.name: Film Production Society (FPS)
clubs.tagline: Bringing stories to life through cinematic frames
clubs.description: The Film Production Society (FPS), a part of the Cultural Council, is a creative community of passionate storytellers, cinematographers, editors, and actors who bring ideas to life on screen. FPS provides students with hands-on exposure to various aspects of filmmaking and helps them explore and develop their interests in different creative domains. Through short films, workshops, collaborative projects, sponsorships, and campus events, the society fosters creativity, teamwork, innovation, and a vibrant film culture while encouraging students to showcase their talent and potential.
key_projects: Senior Batch Farewell Film & Freshman Welcomes

clubs.name: The Pixel Snappers (Photography Club)
clubs.tagline: Freezing moments, framing perspectives
clubs.description: The Pixel Snappers, the Photography Club of the Cultural Council, is a visual storytelling hub where students capture moments that define campus life. It brings together photography enthusiasts who explore various genres, including portrait, landscape, street and event photography, refining their creative experimentation. The Pixel Snappers ensures that performances, competitions, and candid campus experiences are beautifully documented.
flagship_events: Annual Campus Photography Exhibition at Cultscape
key_projects: Institute Annual Convocation & Dignitary Visual Archives
Faces of IIT Bhilai Photo Series

clubs.name: Sports Council & Inter-IIT Contingent
clubs.tagline: Forging grit, discipline, and athletic supremacy
clubs.description: The Sports Council governs athletics and physical training at IIT Bhilai. It operates training wings for Cricket, Football, Basketball, Volleyball, Badminton, Table Tennis, Chess, Athletics, and Yoga, preparing student athletes to compete in the prestigious Inter-IIT Sports Meet.

clubs.name: Polaris (Student Mentorship Program)
clubs.tagline: Guiding every newcomer toward thriving campus life
clubs.description: Polaris is the official Student Mentorship Program (SMP) and transition platform of IIT Bhilai. Senior peer mentors are paired with incoming freshmen to assist with hostel onboarding, course registration on AIMS, academic navigation, and mental well-being.
key_projects: Polaris Online Freshman Portal & Survival Guide

clubs.name: National Service Scheme (NSS)
clubs.tagline: Not Me, But You — Serving society with empathy and purpose
clubs.description: The National Service Scheme unit of IIT Bhilai engages technocrats in voluntary community welfare, rural education in neighboring villages of Durg, blood donation camps, digital literacy programs, and environmental cleanliness drives.
flagship_events: Tree Plantation Drives on Kutelabhata Campus
key_projects: Free Evening Remedial Classes for Village Children

clubs.name: Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat (EBSB)
clubs.tagline: Celebrating cultural unity and regional heritage
clubs.description: EBSB at IIT Bhilai promotes national integration and cultural appreciation. The club organizes regional food festivals, linguistic exchange workshops, traditional dress galas, and seminars highlighting heritage ties between paired states.

clubs.name: SPIC MACAY IIT Bhilai Chapter
clubs.tagline: Enriching minds with classical heritage, mysticism, and folk wisdom
clubs.description: The Society for the Promotion of Indian Classical Music And Culture Amongst Youth (SPIC MACAY) chapter at IIT Bhilai hosts concerts, workshops, and virasat series featuring Padma awardees and national masters of classical music and dance.

festivals.name: Meraz
festivals.tagline: The Premier Annual Techno-Cultural Extravaganza of Central India
festivals.description: Meraz is IIT Bhilai's flagship annual techno-cultural festival. It features high-stakes competitive hackathons, robowars, pro-nites featuring celebrated Bollywood/indie musicians, fashion competitions, and art exhibits drawing students from across India.

festivals.name: Cultscape
festivals.tagline: Celebrating the Spirit of Artistic Expression
festivals.description: Cultscape is the internal annual cultural fest celebrating dance, dramatics, music, fine arts, and poetry, allowing campus students to express their creative identities.

festivals.name: Prayatna
festivals.description: Prayatna is the institute's annual sports championship featuring intense battles in Cricket, Football, Volleyball, Basketball, Badminton, Table Tennis, Chess, Athletics, and LAN Gaming.

festivals.name: ExQuizite
festivals.description: Quizzotica's flagship annual quizzing fest featuring multi-genre quizzes curated by renowned quizmasters across India.

festivals.name: Saaz
festivals.description: Swara's signature music fest featuring acoustic outdoor evenings, instrumental face-offs, and rock band competitions.
